answer: The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, expired if not renewed by fresh work, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. What survives to the copper is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The opal holds work receipts rather than names, so the jade of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
